docs.summary: A world-space off-mesh connection fed into a bake (the payload of [`NavMeshLink`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshLink)). Self-contained — no Transform or component references — so it is safe to hand to a background build. A link with [`Width`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshLinkSource~Width) > 0 is expanded into parallel connections across the span, so an agent enters at the nearest point along it.
World-space endpoints. Each must land within the agent radius of walkable surface for the connection to attach.
World-space endpoints. Each must land within the agent radius of walkable surface for the connection to attach.
World-space width of the link: how wide a span of the edge it covers. 0 leaves the connection at the agent's own radius.
Whether the link can be traversed end-to-start as well.
The link's area (see [`NavMeshAreas`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshAreas)); traversal cost comes from the area's cost.
Stable user id stamped on the baked connection, used to resolve a traversing agent back to its [`NavMeshLink`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshLink) component. 0 = none.

docs.summary: The crossing points this link becomes: one per parallel connection, spread across [`Width`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshLinkSource~Width) (capped at 8). A wide link should let an agent enter at the nearest point along its entry edge, but a Detour off-mesh connection is a single point, so a span is approximated by several of them side by side and the agent takes the nearest. Re-expanded every time the cache re-contours a tile.

params.agentRadius: Bake agent radius: the connection radius, the spacing between parallel connections, and the inset that keeps the outermost ones on the span.
